actions: Locate oak trees in the current area by exploring nearby forests or woodlands.
Approach an oak tree that is at least 2 blocks tall.
Break the oak log block using your hand or any available tool.
Collect the dropped oak log until you have gathered 7 oak logs.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 7 oak logs.
Open your crafting table interface.
Place 1 oak_log into the crafting grid.
Craft oak_planks from the oak_log.
Collect the 4 oak_planks from the crafting output.
Repeat steps 2-4 a total of 3 times to obtain 12 oak_planks.
Open your inventory to view available items.
Confirm that you have 4 oak_planks in your inventory.
Locate a crafting table or a crafting interface in your current environment.
Select the oak_planks from your inventory.
Arrange 4 oak_planks in the crafting grid to form the crafting_table.
Execute the craft action to create 1 crafting_table.
Confirm that the crafting_table has been added to your inventory.
Open your crafting table interface.
Place 2 oak planks into the crafting grid.
Craft 4 sticks from the 2 oak planks.
Collect the 4 sticks into your inventory.
Repeat steps 1 to 4 to craft another 4 sticks from 2 more oak planks.
Collect the second set of 4 sticks into your inventory.
Check your inventory to verify that you have a total of 8 sticks.
Open your crafting table interface again.
Place 2 oak planks into the crafting grid.
Craft 4 sticks from the 2 oak planks.
Collect the final 4 sticks into your inventory.
Check your inventory to verify that you now have a total of 12 sticks.
Confirm that you have successfully obtained at least 9 sticks.
Open your inventory and verify that you have 3 oak_planks and 2 sticks available.
Place the crafting_table on the ground in a suitable location.
Right-click on the crafting_table to open the crafting interface.
In the crafting grid, place 3 oak_planks in the top row.
Place 1 stick in the center square of the crafting grid.
Place 1 stick in the bottom center square of the crafting grid.
Verify that the crafting result shows 1 wooden_pickaxe.
Drag the wooden_pickaxe from the crafting result into your inventory.
Locate a stone block in your current area.
Equip your wooden_pickaxe from your inventory.
Use your wooden_pickaxe to mine the stone block.
Collect the cobblestone that drops from the mined stone block.
Repeat steps 1 to 4 until you have obtained a total of 11 cobblestone in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 11 cobblestone.
Open your inventory to confirm you have 3 cobblestones and 2 sticks.
Approach your crafting_table.
Right-click on the crafting_table to open the crafting interface.
In the crafting grid, place 3 cobblestones in the bottom row.
Place 1 stick in the center square of the crafting grid.
Place 1 stick in the square directly above the center stick.
Verify that the stone_pickaxe appears as a result in the crafting output.
Drag the stone_pickaxe from the crafting output to your inventory.
Close the crafting interface to complete the crafting process.
Locate a nearby cave or area with exposed coal ore.
Equip the wooden_pickaxe from your inventory.
Approach a coal ore block within reach.
Mine the coal ore block using the wooden_pickaxe.
Collect the dropped coal item after mining.
Repeat steps 3 to 5 to mine a total of 3 coal ore blocks.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 3 coal items.
Open your inventory to verify that you have 8 cobblestone and 1 crafting_table available.
Approach the crafting_table you have in your inventory.
Place the crafting_table on the ground by right-clicking on the ground.
Right-click on the crafting_table to open the crafting interface.
In the crafting grid, place 8 cobblestone in all available slots.
Ensure that the crafting interface shows the furnace as the output item.
Drag the furnace from the crafting grid into your inventory to complete the crafting process.
Close the crafting interface to finish your task.
Locate a cave or mountain area where iron ore is commonly found.
Equip the stone pickaxe from your inventory.
Approach the iron ore blocks in the area.
Use the stone pickaxe to mine the first iron ore block.
Collect the mined iron ore and add it to your inventory.
Repeat the process of mining iron ore and collecting it until you have mined a total of 7 iron ore blocks.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 7 iron ore blocks.
If necessary, return to your crafting table to smelt the iron ore into raw iron using the furnace.
Open your inventory to check the quantity of raw iron you have.
Ensure you have at least 7 raw iron in your inventory to smelt into iron ingots.
Place the furnace on the ground in a suitable location.
Open the furnace interface by right-clicking on the furnace.
Move 1 raw iron from your inventory into the top slot of the furnace.
Move 1 piece of coal from your inventory into the bottom slot of the furnace.
Wait for the furnace to smelt the raw iron into 1 iron ingot.
Once the smelting is complete, move the iron ingot from the furnace to your inventory.
Repeat steps 5 to 8 a total of 6 more times to smelt the remaining raw iron into iron ingots.
Verify that your inventory now contains exactly 7 iron ingots.
Open your crafting table interface.
Place 3 iron ingots in the crafting grid, filling the top row completely.
Place 1 stick in the center slot of the crafting grid.
Place 1 stick in the bottom center slot of the crafting grid.
Verify that the crafting grid displays an iron pickaxe as the result.
Drag the iron pickaxe into your inventory.
Open your inventory to check the available items.
Verify that you have at least 3 iron ingots in your inventory.
Ensure that you have a crafting table available in your inventory.
Place the crafting table on the ground in your current location.
Right-click the crafting table to open the crafting interface.
In the crafting interface, place 3 iron ingots in the crafting grid.
Ensure that the iron ingots are arranged in a V shape (one in the middle and one on each side).
Observe that a bucket appears as a craftable item in the result box of the crafting interface.
Drag the bucket from the result box into your inventory.
Verify that your inventory now contains 1 bucket.
Locate a cave or mountainous area where diamond ore is commonly found.
Equip the iron pickaxe from your inventory.
Mine diamond ore blocks using the iron pickaxe.
Collect the diamonds dropped from the mined diamond ore until you have 29 diamonds in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 29 diamonds.
Locate a nearby gravel block in your current environment.
Equip your stone pickaxe from your inventory.
Approach the gravel block you have located.
Break the gravel block using your stone pickaxe.
Collect any items that drop from the broken gravel block.
Check your inventory to see if you have obtained at least 1 flint.
If you have not yet obtained flint, repeat steps 4 and 5 until you collect 1 flint.
Locate a body of water near your current location.
Approach the edge of the water source.
Select the bucket from your inventory.
Right-click on the water source to pour the water into the bucket.
Verify that you now have 1 water_bucket in your inventory.
Open your inventory to check the available items.
Verify that you have 3 diamonds in your inventory.
Verify that you have 2 sticks in your inventory.
Verify that you have 1 crafting table in your inventory.
Approach the crafting table in your vicinity.
Right-click on the crafting table to open the crafting interface.
Place 3 diamonds in the top row of the crafting grid.
Place 1 stick in the center square of the crafting grid.
Place 1 stick in the bottom center square of the crafting grid.
Confirm that the diamond pickaxe appears as the resulting item in the crafting interface.
Drag the diamond pickaxe from the crafting interface to your inventory.
Open your inventory to confirm that you have 1 iron_ingot and 1 flint available.
Approach the crafting_table that you have in your inventory.
Right-click on the crafting_table to open the crafting interface.
In the crafting grid, place 1 iron_ingot in any slot.
Place 1 flint in any empty slot of the crafting grid.
Verify that the crafting grid shows 1 flint_and_steel as the result.
Drag the flint_and_steel from the result box into your inventory.
Close the crafting interface to complete the crafting process.
Ensure that you have a diamond pickaxe in your inventory.
Make sure you have a water bucket in your inventory.
Locate a lava pool in your current area.
Approach the lava pool carefully to avoid falling in.
Use the water bucket to pour water over the lava, creating obsidian blocks.
Identify the obsidian blocks formed by the water and lava interaction.
Equip your diamond pickaxe from your inventory.
Mine the first obsidian block until it breaks and is collected in your inventory.
Repeat the mining process for the next obsidian block until you have mined a total of 10 obsidian blocks.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 10 obsidian.
Open your inventory to check the available items.
Confirm that you have at least 4 diamonds in your inventory.
Locate the crafting table in your current area.
Approach the crafting table.
Right-click on the crafting table to open the crafting interface.
In the crafting grid, place 4 diamonds in the slots to craft the diamond boots.
Drag the diamond boots from the crafting output slot into your inventory.
Verify that you now have 1 diamond_boots in your inventory.
Open your inventory and confirm you have 7 diamonds and 1 crafting_table.
Locate the crafting_table in your inventory.
Select the crafting_table and place it on the ground.
Right-click on the crafting_table to open the crafting interface.
In the crafting grid, place 7 diamonds in the appropriate slots to craft diamond_leggings.
Once the diamond_leggings appear as the result, click on them to collect them into your inventory.
Verify that your inventory now contains 1 diamond_leggings.
Open your inventory to confirm you have 8 diamonds available.
Place the crafting table on the ground in your current location.
Right-click on the crafting table to open the crafting interface.
In the crafting grid, place 8 diamonds in the pattern for a diamond chestplate.
Verify that the diamond chestplate appears in the result box of the crafting interface.
Drag the diamond chestplate into your inventory.
Close the crafting interface to complete the crafting process.
Open your inventory and verify that you have at least 5 diamonds.
Locate the crafting_table in your inventory.
Select the crafting_table to place it on the ground.
Approach the crafting_table and right-click on it to open the crafting interface.
In the crafting interface, place 5 diamonds in the crafting grid.
Verify that the crafting recipe displays a diamond_helmet in the result box.
Drag the diamond_helmet from the result box into your inventory.
Confirm that your inventory now contains 1 diamond_helmet.
Open your inventory to verify that you have 2 diamonds and 1 stick.
Ensure that you have a crafting table placed in your current location.
Right-click on the crafting table to open the crafting interface.
In the crafting grid, place 2 diamonds in the first two slots of the first row.
Place 1 stick in the center slot of the second row in the crafting grid.
Observe that the diamond sword icon appears in the result slot of the crafting interface.
Drag the diamond sword from the result slot into your inventory.
Confirm that your inventory now contains 1 diamond_sword.
Verify that you have 10 obsidian blocks in your inventory.
Ensure that you have 1 flint_and_steel in your inventory.
Find a suitable location to build the nether portal, preferably a flat area with enough space.
Place 4 obsidian blocks in a vertical column to form one side of the portal.
Place 4 obsidian blocks in a vertical column parallel to the first column to form the opposite side of the portal.
Connect the two columns using 2 obsidian blocks at the top and 2 obsidian blocks at the bottom to form a rectangular frame.
Ensure the portal frame is 4 blocks tall and 5 blocks wide, leaving the center open.
Once the frame is complete, take out your flint_and_steel from your inventory.
Use the flint_and_steel on the inside of the portal frame to ignite it and activate the nether portal.
Confirm that the nether portal is now lit and ready for use.
Locate the nether portal in your inventory.
Use the flint and steel to ignite the nether portal.
Step into the nether portal to enter the Nether dimension.
Once in the Nether, look for a biome that contains blazes, such as a Nether fortress.
Navigate towards the Nether fortress while being cautious of hostile mobs.
Locate a blaze spawner within the fortress.
Equip your diamond sword from your inventory.
Approach the blaze spawner and prepare for combat.
Attack the blazes until one of them is defeated.
Collect the blaze rod dropped by the defeated blaze.
Verify that your inventory now contains exactly 1 blaze_rod.
Open your inventory and locate the blaze_rod.
Move the blaze_rod into the crafting grid of the crafting_table.
Ensure that the crafting grid shows the option to craft blaze_powder.
Craft the blaze_powder using 1 blaze_rod.
Confirm that you now have 2 blaze_powder in your inventory.
Check that your inventory contains at least 1 blaze_powder.
Equip the diamond sword from your inventory.
Locate a biome where endermen commonly spawn, such as the Overworld at night or the End.
Search for an enderman in the area.
Approach the enderman carefully, ensuring you are within striking distance.
Attack the enderman with your diamond sword.
Avoid looking directly at the enderman to prevent it from teleporting away.
Continue to attack the enderman until it is defeated.
Wait for the enderman to drop its loot.
Collect the ender pearl that the enderman drops into your inventory.
Open your inventory to check the available items.
Ensure you have 1 ender_pearl in your inventory.
Ensure you have 1 blaze_powder in your inventory.
Approach the crafting_table in your vicinity.
Open the crafting interface of the crafting_table.
Place the 1 ender_pearl in the first slot of the crafting grid.
Place the 1 blaze_powder in the second slot of the crafting grid.
Observe the recipe output for ender_eye in the crafting result slot.
Drag the ender_eye into your inventory.
Confirm that you now have 1 ender_eye in your inventory.
